The Towards Climate-Smart Humanitarian and Development Organisations executive programme is part of ECAS Institute's 2026–2030 Strategic Capacity Development Catalogue under Climate Change & Sustainability. This practical, practitioner-led course is designed to equip senior officers, policymakers, technical specialists, and development practitioners with internationally recognized methodologies, real-world case studies, and actionable institutional frameworks.

TARGET PARTICIPANTS

  • Senior and middle-level officers in national and county/sub-national governments, ministries, and parastatals
  • Project managers, technical advisors, and M&E specialists in development agencies and NGOs
  • Private sector executives, sustainability leads, and corporate governance professionals
  • Researchers, policy analysts, and institutional focal points

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

  • Master core concepts, global best practices, and emerging African policy frameworks in Towards Climate-Smart Humanitarian and Development Organisations.
  • Analyze real-world institutional challenges and apply practical tools, models, and diagnostic templates.
  • Strengthen organizational compliance, governance, reporting, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Develop an actionable Institutional Implementation Plan tailored to your organization's mandate.

COURSE OUTLINE

Module 1: Foundations, Policy Landscape & Strategic Context

  • Global and regional trends, regulatory frameworks, and institutional mandates
  • Key concepts, principles, and emerging operational challenges in Towards Climate-Smart Humanitarian and Development Organisations

Module 2: Technical Frameworks, Tools & Methodologies

  • Core analytical models, planning methodologies, and operational standards
  • Case studies from public sector ministries, utilities, and international development programmes

Module 3: Implementation, Risk Management & Quality Assurance

  • Identifying operational, financial, and governance risks and designing mitigation safeguards
  • Stakeholder mapping, cross-functional coordination, and change management

Module 4: Monitoring, Reporting & Performance Measurement

  • Designing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), results chains, and accountability dashboards
  • Data-driven decision-making and best-practice reporting

Module 5: Practical Simulation & Institutional Action Planning

  • Hands-on group exercises, scenario simulations, and peer review
  • Developing a customized Institutional Action Plan for immediate workplace application

TRAINING CUSTOMIZATION

This training can also be customized for your institution upon request. You can also have it delivered at your preferred location (In-House, Classroom in Nairobi/Arusha/Mombasa/Naivasha/Kigali/Dubai/Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), or Online).

DIGITAL CERTIFICATION

Participants who successfully complete the programme will receive an official ECAS Institute Certificate of Completion recognized across public and private sector institutions.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Participants should be reasonably proficient in English. During the trainings, participants should come with their own laptops for practical sessions and simulations.

TRAINING FEE

  • Kenyans (5 days): USD 1,200
  • Kenyans (10 working days / 2 Weeks): USD 2,000
  • International participants (10 working days / 2 Weeks): USD 2,500
  • 3–4 Weeks Executive Programme: USD 3,000
  • The course fee covers the course tuition, training materials, stationery, and daytime refreshments during physical sessions.
  • We are open for institutional negotiations and can customize courses based on your availability, cohort size, and budget.

communicating-with-impact-for-senior-lea.content:
OVERVIEW

The Communicating with Impact for Senior Leadership executive programme is part of ECAS Institute's 2026–2030 Strategic Capacity Development Catalogue under Human Resources, Office Administration & Communication. This practical, practitioner-led course is designed to equip senior officers, policymakers, technical specialists, and development practitioners with internationally recognized methodologies, real-world case studies, and actionable institutional frameworks.

TARGET PARTICIPANTS

  • Senior and middle-level officers in national and county/sub-national governments, ministries, and parastatals
  • Project managers, technical advisors, and M&E specialists in development agencies and NGOs
  • Private sector executives, sustainability leads, and corporate governance professionals
  • Researchers, policy analysts, and institutional focal points

WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

  • Master core concepts, global best practices, and emerging African policy frameworks in Communicating with Impact for Senior Leadership.
  • Analyze real-world institutional challenges and apply practical tools, models, and diagnostic templates.
  • Strengthen organizational compliance, governance, reporting, and stakeholder engagement strategies.
  • Develop an actionable Institutional Implementation Plan tailored to your organization's mandate.

COURSE OUTLINE

Module 1: Foundations, Policy Landscape & Strategic Context

  • Global and regional trends, regulatory frameworks, and institutional mandates
  • Key concepts, principles, and emerging operational challenges in Communicating with Impact for Senior Leadership

Module 2: Technical Frameworks, Tools & Methodologies

  • Core analytical models, planning methodologies, and operational standards
  • Case studies from public sector ministries, utilities, and international development programmes

Module 3: Implementation, Risk Management & Quality Assurance

  • Identifying operational, financial, and governance risks and designing mitigation safeguards
  • Stakeholder mapping, cross-functional coordination, and change management

Module 4: Monitoring, Reporting & Performance Measurement

  • Designing Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), results chains, and accountability dashboards
  • Data-driven decision-making and best-practice reporting

Module 5: Practical Simulation & Institutional Action Planning

  • Hands-on group exercises, scenario simulations, and peer review
  • Developing a customized Institutional Action Plan for immediate workplace application

TRAINING CUSTOMIZATION

This training can also be customized for your institution upon request. You can also have it delivered at your preferred location (In-House, Classroom in Nairobi/Arusha/Mombasa/Naivasha/Kigali/Dubai/Kuala Lumpur (Malaysia), or Online).

DIGITAL CERTIFICATION

Participants who successfully complete the programme will receive an official ECAS Institute Certificate of Completion recognized across public and private sector institutions.

REQUIREMENTS

  • Participants should be reasonably proficient in English. During the trainings, participants should come with their own laptops for practical sessions and simulations.

TRAINING FEE

  • Kenyans (5 days): USD 1,200
  • Kenyans (10 working days / 2 Weeks): USD 2,000
  • International participants (10 working days / 2 Weeks): USD 2,500
  • 3–4 Weeks Executive Programme: USD 3,000
  • The course fee covers the course tuition, training materials, stationery, and daytime refreshments during physical sessions.
  • We are open for institutional negotiations and can customize courses based on your availability, cohort size, and budget.

training-on-health-insurance-claims-mana.title: Training on Health Insurance Claims Management and Fraud Detection
training-on-health-insurance-claims-mana.summary: Comprehensive professional training on health insurance claims processing, auditing, tariff management, fraud detection analytics, risk mitigation, and compliance frameworks for healthcare and insurance professionals.
training-on-health-insurance-claims-mana.content:
OVERVIEW

Health insurance claims management and fraud detection is critical for ensuring financial sustainability, operational integrity, and fair healthcare delivery. This course provides participants with specialized skills in claims adjudication, forensic auditing, tariff and billing reconciliation, digital claims automation, and data analytics for detecting fraudulent, abusive, or wasteful healthcare claims.

WHO SHOULD ATTEND

  • Health insurance managers, claims officers, underwriters, and medical auditors
  • Hospital administrators, medical superintendents, and healthcare billing accountants
  • Internal auditors, forensic investigators, compliance officers, and risk managers
  • Public healthcare scheme administrators (NHIF, SHA, community health funds)
  • Medical scheme trustees, corporate HR wellness managers, and benefits administrators

COURSE OBJECTIVES

  • Understand end-to-end health insurance claims lifecycles and adjudication principles
  • Implement robust claims validation, pre-authorization, and medical necessity review protocols
  • Identify common healthcare fraud typologies: phantom billing, unbundling, upcoding, and identity theft
  • Leverage data analytics, anomaly detection, and audit algorithms to flag suspicious claims
  • Design internal control frameworks to prevent revenue leakage and institutional fraud
  • Navigate regulatory compliance, patient privacy (data protection laws), and contractual agreements

COURSE MODULES & SPECIALIZED TRACKS

  • Module 1: Foundations of Health Insurance & Medical Claims Ecosystem
  • Module 2: Claims Processing Workflow, Pre-Authorizations & Adjudication Rules
  • Module 3: Medical Coding & Tariff Systems (ICD-10, CPT, DRG, Fee-for-Service vs Capitation)
  • Module 4: Healthcare Fraud, Waste, and Abuse (FWA): Typologies & Red Flags
  • Module 5: Forensic Claims Auditing & Evidence Gathering Techniques
  • Module 6: Data Analytics, AI & Anomaly Detection in Health Claims
  • Module 7: Provider Relationship Management, Contracts & Dispute Resolution
  • Module 8: Regulatory Compliance, Patient Data Privacy & Legal Remedies

TRAINING CUSTOMIZATION & IN-HOUSE DELIVERY

This training can also be tailored for your healthcare facility, insurance company, or national health agency. We can deliver it in-house at your organization, across executive classroom locations (Nairobi, Mombasa, Kigali, Arusha, Dubai, Kuala Lumpur - Malaysia), or virtually via our interactive digital learning platform.

CERTIFICATION

Participants who successfully complete the programme will be awarded an official ECAS Institute Executive Certificate of Completion.
